description: This file contains the implementation of the Stream class in the Slim Framework PSR-7 package, providing stream handling functionalities such as reading, writing, seeking, and metadata management for PHP stream resources.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: A class implementing PSR-7 StreamInterface, providing methods to work with PHP stream resources, including reading, writing, seeking, metadata access, and conversion to string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stream object with a PHP resource and optional cache stream, validating the resource and cache suitability.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for the stream or a specific metadata key.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a PHP resource to the stream object, detaching any previous resource.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the current PHP resource from the stream object and resets internal state.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the stream to a string by reading its contents, leveraging cache if available.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream resource and detaches it from the object.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the pointer in the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Determines if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Determines if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the pointer to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream pointer to the beginning.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads remaining contents from the stream.

methods.name: isPipe
methods.description: Determines if the stream is a pipe.
